proposed.text: What does Section 5-c say about commissions already known to be endowed to another architect?

options.text: The architect shall not seek them, whether agreed or still under negotiation.
The architect may seek them if the fee is lower.
The architect may seek them if no drawings are complete.
The architect must seek them to protect the client.

proposed.rationale: Section 5-c bars seeking commissions already known to be endowed to another architect, whether agreed or still under negotiation.
